svg.title: ZFP36L2 nsSNPs: AlphaFold 3 + MD pipeline and summary
svg.desc: Figure 0 of the ZFP36L2_AF3 write-up. Hand-editable: every block is a named group. Palette - deleterious #eb6834, neutral #2a78d6, AlphaFold 3 #6250d6, MD #008300, ink #0b0b0b / #52514e, muted #898781, hairline #e1e0d9, wash #f5f4f0.

g.text: ZFP36L2 · ALPHAFOLD 3 + MOLECULAR DYNAMICS · PAUSED OCTOBER 2026
Can MD on AlphaFold 3 models separate harmful from harmless ZFP36L2 variants?
Ten constructs of the ZFP36L2 tandem zinc-finger domain, predicted with AlphaFold 3, simulated with MD, and scored against EMSA labels from Akçeşme et al. 2025.
T156 H-bonds per run · gray = wild type
Stacking lead fails the wild-type check
10 folders × 4 run sets · color = protein simulated
No result here can be significant
Once 16 misfiled wild-type runs are removed, no MD readout survives correction.
Paused, not abandoned: re-run the 16 Anvil replicates with the right variants, from several AF3 models, and pre-register one readout.
Labels: Akçeşme et al., RNA Biology 2025, doi:10.1080/15476286.2024.2437590
